harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified a persistent CentOS 5 iptables firewall on node1. SSH remains allowed from any IPv4 source; TCP/9000 is accepted only from node2 (10.100.85.11) and explicitly rejected from node3 and all other sources. All three nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Preserved the installed CentOS 5.11 release and 2.6.18-398.el5 kernel.
Backed up node1's original firewall configuration.
Added ordered TCP/9000 source-allow and fallback-reject rules while retaining the any-source SSH rule.
Saved the rules to /etc/sysconfig/iptables and enabled iptables for runlevels 2–5.
Verified node2 received HTTP 200 on TCP/9000, node3 was rejected, and both retained SSH access.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually, waiting for full recovery before proceeding.
Repeated firewall behavior checks after restarts and removed the temporary TCP/9000 test listener.

evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall and legacy-platform compatibility
evidence.summary: Shows identical live and persisted rules, iptables boot enablement, CentOS 5.11/kernel 2.6.18 retained, and the firewall remaining active after test-listener cleanup.
Node2 and node3 both successfully connected to node1 SSH; final rules and counters show the unrestricted TCP/22 ACCEPT rule.

evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 and rejected from node3/everywhere else
evidence.summary: Node2 received HTTP 200, node3 received a failed connection, and firewall counters recorded both ACCEPT traffic from 10.100.85.11 and fallback REJECT traffic. The persisted fallback rule covers every other IPv4 source.

Healthy baseline boot ID 55fc4a00-9697-494d-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID cf35d2dc-5db7-4808-8000-000000000000, recovered SSH and firewall rules, followed by successful node2 allow and node3 reject tests.
Healthy baseline boot ID 9b2c3c8a-2d02-42dc-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6669d4f7-b705-45d2-8000-000000000000, and recovered SSH plus permitted TCP/9000 connectivity.

Healthy baseline boot ID c362e1bd-f5c0-4758-8000-000000000000 and reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 638caed5-6622-49c8-8000-000000000000, recovered SSH, continued node1 SSH access, and continued TCP/9000 rejection.
